# =============================================================================
# Step 2B + 3B: Group-specific Matching + Stacked DiD
# =============================================================================
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(fixest)

df_monthly<-fread('//Client/G$/My Drive/DataCen/Code/GDrive_DataCenter/df_monthly.csv')
Gs       <- sort(df_monthly[!is.na(first_treat_month), unique(first_treat_month)])
out_list <- list()

for (g in Gs) {
  g      <- as.Date(g)
  prev_m <- g %m-% months(1)
  
  d_treated <- df_monthly[month_id == prev_m & first_treat_month == g]
  d_control <- df_monthly[month_id == prev_m &
                     (is.na(first_treat_month) | first_treat_month > g)]
  
  if (nrow(d_treated) == 0 | nrow(d_control) == 0) next
  
  M <- rbind(
    d_treated[, .(pixel_id_hash, STUSPS,
                  temp_lag1, temp_lag2, temp_lag3,
                  dc_counts, treated = 1L)],
    d_control[, .(pixel_id_hash, STUSPS,
                  temp_lag1, temp_lag2, temp_lag3,
                  dc_counts, treated = 0L)]
  )
  M <- na.omit(M, cols = c("temp_lag1", "temp_lag2", "temp_lag3", "dc_counts"))
  M <- unique(M, by = "pixel_id_hash")
  if (nrow(M) == 0) next
  if (length(unique(M$treated)) < 2) next
  
  M_df           <- as.data.frame(M)
  rownames(M_df) <- M_df$pixel_id_hash
  
  m_out <- try(
    matchit(
      treated ~ temp_lag1 + temp_lag2 + temp_lag3 + dc_counts,
      data     = M_df,
      method   = "nearest",
      distance = "glm",
      exact    = ~STUSPS,
      ratio    = 1,
      replace  = FALSE
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  if (inherits(m_out, "try-error")) next
  
  m_units <- as.data.table(
    match.data(m_out)[, c("pixel_id_hash", "treated", "weights")]
  )
  
  treated_px <- m_units[treated == 1L, pixel_id_hash]
  control_px <- m_units[treated == 0L, pixel_id_hash]
  
  p_g <- df_monthly[pixel_id_hash %in% m_units$pixel_id_hash]
  p_g[, treated := NULL]
  p_g <- merge(p_g,
               m_units[, .(pixel_id_hash, treated, weights)],
               by    = "pixel_id_hash",
               all.x = FALSE)
  
  # Censor not-yet-treated controls at their own treatment date
  p_g <- p_g[
    pixel_id_hash %in% treated_px |
      (pixel_id_hash %in% control_px &
         (is.na(first_treat_month) | month_id < first_treat_month))
  ]
  
  p_g[, event_g    := g]
  p_g[, event_time := as.integer(round(
    (as.yearmon(month_id) - as.yearmon(g)) * 12
  ))]
  p_g <- p_g[abs(event_time) <= 24]
  if (nrow(p_g) == 0) next
  
  out_list[[as.character(g)]] <- p_g
}

stacked_df <- rbindlist(out_list, fill = TRUE)
stacked_df[, unit_g := interaction(pixel_id_hash, event_g, drop = TRUE)]
stacked_df[, event_time_plot := fifelse(treated == 1L, event_time, -1L)]
stacked_df[, post := as.integer(event_time >= 0)]
stacked_df[, nflx := as.integer(treated == 1L & post == 1L)]
stacked_df[, event_time_plot := fifelse(treated == 1L, event_time, -1L)]
cat("Treated pixels:", stacked_df[treated == 1, uniqueN(pixel_id_hash)], "\n")
cat("Control pixels:", stacked_df[treated == 0, uniqueN(pixel_id_hash)], "\n")
cat("Cohorts:       ", stacked_df[, uniqueN(event_g)], "\n")
```
# =============================================================================
# Step 3B: DiD on matched sample
# =============================================================================
```{r}
step3b <- feols(
  c(temp, nighttemp, daytemp) ~ nflx |
    pixel_id_hash + month_id^STUSPS,
  cluster = ~pixel_id_hash,
  weights = ~weights,
  data    = stacked_df
)

etable(step3b,
       dict = c(
         temp      = "LST (All)",
         nighttemp = "LST (Night)",
         daytemp   = "LST (Day)",
         nflx      = "Netflix OCA"
       ),
       title = "Step 3B: DiD on Group-Matched Sample"
)
```
# Event study Plot
```{r}

step3b_es <- feols(
  daytemp ~ i(event_time_plot, ref = -1) |
    pixel_id_hash + month_id^STUSPS,
  cluster = ~pixel_id_hash,
  data    = stacked_df
)

iplot(step3b_es,
      main = "Step 3B: Event Study (Day LST, Matched Sample)",
      xlab = "Months relative to treatment"
)
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)
stacked_df <-stacked_df %>% mutate( rt_quarter= ifelse(treated==1, floor(event_time_plot/4),-1))

step3_qt<-feols(daytemp ~ i(rt_quarter, ref = -1)
                   | pixel_id_hash + month_id^STUSPS,  cluster = ~pixel_id_hash,
               data = stacked_df )
```

# =============================================================================
# Step 4: FECT on matched sample 
# =============================================================================
```{r}
library(fect)

matched_px <- stacked_df[, unique(pixel_id_hash)]
setDT(df_monthly)
# treated_time: 1 if treated AND post-treatment
df_monthly[, treated_time := as.integer(
  !is.na(first_treat_month) & month_id >= first_treat_month
)]

out_fect <- fect(
  daytemp ~ treated_time,
  data     = as.data.frame(df_monthly[pixel_id_hash %in% matched_px]),
  index    = c("pixel_id_hash", "month_id"),
  method   = "ife",
  force    = "two-way",
  se       = TRUE,
  nboots   = 500,
  parallel = FALSE
)

summary(out_fect)
plot(out_fect, main = "FECT: Effect on Daytime LST")

cat("ATT (avg)        :", out_fect$att.avg, "\n")
cat("ATT (unit weight):", out_fect$att.avg.unit, "\n")
```
